description: ADR-0009: grouped weekly updates behind release-age cooldowns; config:best-practices pins the GitHub Action and Docker digests

customManagers.description: Docker images of the workflow linters: actionlint in ci.yml, actionlint and zizmor in the lint:actions script

packageRules.description: ADR-0009 floor: npm major, minor and patch updates wait 7 days instead of the 3 days of security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (config:best-practices); other npm update types keep that preset's handling

devDependency minors and patches wait 14 days and automerge in their own group: Renovate merges a branch by itself only when every update in it may automerge, so they cannot share the group:allNonMajor branch with runtime updates
Bun and the action that installs it in CI update together
GHCR reports no release timestamps, so the release-age check would hold the zizmor image back forever
